_comment: Verification harness for sgl-project/rbg PR #410. Consumed by scripts/re-verify.sh. PR #410 is a docs/agent-skill PR: the 'code under review' is prose that an agent executes, so most findings are proven by asserting the repo facts the prose claims. Production content is untouched by this branch.

findings.claim: PR #410 (yaml-rules.md:6/570/575, SKILL.md:230, PR description) states tolerations are silently dropped when passed through templateRef.patch, and makes that the sole reason to forbid roleTemplates on tainted nodes.
findings.verdict: NOT REPRODUCED — the claim is false. Tolerations survive templateRef.patch at the API-helper level and reach the real Pod on a live cluster.
findings.note: Mixed by design. The four behavior tests PASS on the code under review - that IS the refutation (they would fail if the documented limitation existed; see results/harness-bites.txt) and they must keep passing. TestF1_DocsDoNotClaimTolerationsAreDropped FAILS while the skill still carries the wrong guidance, so re-verify.sh reports F1 as fixed only once the four offending lines in yaml-rules.md / SKILL.md are removed.

findings.claim: CLAUDE.md:14-15 tells the reader to run `make build-cli` and `make build-cli-all`.
findings.verdict: CONFIRMED — neither target exists in the Makefile.

findings.claim: CLAUDE.md:130-135 documents five `kubectl rbg llm ...` commands.
findings.verdict: CONFIRMED — llm.NewLLMCmd is never registered on the CLI root, so the built binary exposes only completion/help/rollout/status.

findings.claim: CLAUDE.md:120-123 lists `RecreateRBGOnPodRestart` as a valid restartPolicy and frames restartPolicy as a role-level field.
findings.verdict: CONFIRMED — the v1alpha2 enum accepts only {None, RecreateRoleInstanceOnPodRestart}; a real API server rejects the value. restartPolicy lives under leaderWorkerPattern / customComponentsPattern, not roles[].
CONFIRMED — 27 (odd) code fences. A stray fence at SKILL.md:200 inverts fence parity for the rest of the file; the `marked` parser loses the Phase 4 / 4.1 / 4.2 headings entirely. One-line fix.

findings.claim: Counter-check of the Copilot review comment on yaml-rules.md:7 asserting that templateRef.patch is optional.
findings.verdict: PR #410 IS RIGHT, the review comment is wrong — the controller rejects templateRef without patch (api/workloads/v1alpha2/roletemplate_validation.go:139), confirmed live via an InvalidTemplateRef event.

liveNote: L3 needs a real cluster with the RBG controller installed. Run scripts/00-setup.sh, then scripts/10-scenario-f1-tolerations.sh (observable signal: the Pod of role 'prefill' carries toleration key verify.rbg.io/pr410, which came only from templateRef.patch; role 'decode' with patch {} carries none), then scripts/30-live-api-validation.sh (observable signal: API server 'Unsupported value: RecreateRBGOnPodRestart', and an InvalidTemplateRef event for the no-patch RBG). Always finish with scripts/99-teardown.sh. Verified against: ACK cn-hongkong, k8s v1.36.1-aliyun.1, controller image rolebasedgroup/rbgs-controller:v0.8.0-cea2a47 in ns rbg-system, 3 untainted nodes.
notVerified: F6 (language consistency: SKILL.md:17 suggests a bilingual switch notice while SKILL.md:369 forbids mixing languages in one response) — a self-consistency reading, no runtime behavior to test.
F7 (SKILL.md declares 'Default language: English' but 4 of the 5 reference files are Chinese-only) — a judgement call about the repo's doc language policy, not a falsifiable claim.

The llmctl command surface used across prerequisites.md / deployment-analysis.md / benchmark.md belongs to the external rolebasedgroup/inference-ext-cli project and was not cross-checked against that repo.
